name: Scroll Shock Trap

stealth.details: (expert) or DC 29 Perception check (expert) to spot the control panel

disable:
DC 25 Thievery check (expert) or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24)

DC 29 Thievery check (master) to disable the entire trap from the hidden control panel beneath the central slab.
reset: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no target creatures and resets after 1 minute.
routine:
(5 actions) Each disabled symbol reduces the trap's number of actions by 1.

For each of its actions, a different symbol shoots an electricity bolt at a random creature in the room. The trap doesn't take multiple attack penalties.

items.text:

HP 64 (BT 32)

Immunities Critical Hits, Object Immunities, Precision Damage

Hardness 18

HP 72 (BT 36)

Resistances Electricity 15

items.name: Reactive Charge
items.text:
Trigger A creature without an Aspis Consortium badge approaches within 5 feet of a slab

---

Effect Both double doors leading out of the room shut and lock. While the trap is active, the doors must be battered open (Hardness 18; Panel HP 72 [BT 36]; DC 29 Athletics check to Force Open). The closest symbol to the triggering creature shoots an electricity bolt attack at it. The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Five scroll symbols shoot electricity bolts around the room.
